items.title: nb theme
items.author: nickbrett1 <https://github.com/nickbrett1>
items.description: The house theme: slate ground, hairline borders as rgba tints, 10px uppercase micro-labels, tabular figures, pill state, 8px card radius, and the single warm cream note reserved for search-match highlight. Lifted verbatim from stratechery-search, where it was the de-facto source of truth, so that no project needs to hand-copy it again.
